# Stonehenge

Type: Structure | Internal ID: StoneHenge1 to | StoneHenge6 | Location: Plains | Resources: Stonehenge Center Chest | Inhabitants: Fuling Berserker | Fuling

# Introduction

Stonehenges are permanent structures found in Plains. They are a formation of large boulders placed on top of each other, either in a circle or by themselves.

## Resources

Stonehenges comes in 6 variants. Each variant features one or more of the following features:
• A chance for a Vegvisir that marks the location of the closest Yagluth's Forsaken Altars.
• A chance for a Stonehenge Center Chest that rarely contains a Fuling totem.
• A chance for Fuling berserkers or Fulings protecting the zone.

## List of variants

• Id: StoneHenge1 | Number per world: 5 | Vegvisir: 40% | Chest: 50% | Creatures: 0–3 Fuling Berserkers

• Id: StoneHenge2 | Number per world: 5 | Vegvisir: no | Chest: 50% | Creatures: 0–3 Fuling Berserkers

• Id: StoneHenge3 | Number per world: 5 | Vegvisir: 40% | Chest: 50% | Creatures: 0–3 Fuling Berserkers

• Id: StoneHenge4 | Number per world: 5 | Vegvisir: 40% | Chest: no | Creatures: 0–2 Fuling Berserkers

• Id: StoneHenge5 | Number per world: 20 | Vegvisir: 40% | Chest: no | Creatures: 0–3 Fulings

• Id: StoneHenge6 | Number per world: 20 | Vegvisir: no | Chest: no | Creatures: no

## Notes

• Stonehenges were inspired by their real-life counterpart of the same name found in Wiltshire, England. The real pre-historic monument is said to have been constructed over 5000 years ago.
